scope: Pilot-informed formal descriptive replication, individual choices and stated reasons; no new group simulations or human participants

questions.A: How does LLM willingness change with the relative cost, compared with the adjusted reference formula under the shared base payoff specification?
questions.B: How does willingness change with supplied earlier-development time forecasts in the physical extension?

sampling: One fresh request per condition in each of30 scheduling blocks; shuffle all28 within each block, then concatenate blocks. Blocks are time/scheduling units, not people or paired simulation trajectories.
sampleRationale: Thirty per condition balances full scenario coverage and full-text reason review, not a formal power guarantee. Independent-binomial Wilson half-width at p=.5,n30 is about.1685 as a scale reference only; model requests need not be independent. Primary summaries average per-block contrasts; no result-driven extension.

primaryA.name: relative_cost_response_difference
primaryA.formula: Per block, mean over av(.3,.7) and wording(numeric,contextual): (Y_R90-Y_R10)-(pRef_R90-pRef_R10); then mean over30 blocks
primaryA.reference: Adjusted reference-law probability, not a global optimum or a complete belief specification supplied to the LLM

primaryB.name: forecast_minus_geometry
primaryB.formula: Per block, equal mean over8 physical scenarios of Y_forecast-Y_geometry; then mean over30 blocks
primaryB.scope: Information-and-prompt condition difference, not isolated reasoning, human realism, group evacuation benefit or proof of mediation

intervals.method: Resample whole scheduling blocks with replacement, recomputing mean contrast
intervals.coverage: Pointwise descriptive95%, conditional on these model/prompt/scenarios and exchangeable scheduling blocks
intervals.multiplicity: Two separately named descriptive summaries, no joint95% coverage or significance claims. All other cell, scale, wording, layout/work or reason comparisons secondary/exploratory.

secondary: Full three-level cost profile, scale and wording patterns
Twelve reason labels and quality fields, separated by task/information; no hidden-reasoning or motive causality

reasonAnalysis.coverage: All840 valid readable reasons, exact spans and named assistant reviewer; no second human agreement claim
reasonAnalysis.denominator: Reviewed eligible reasons per task/scenario/information, with planned/readable/reviewed/unreviewed shown
reasonAnalysis.quality: Retain and code insufficient, contradictory, arithmetic and unsupported-info reasons; do not repair/relabel raw action or exclude inconvenient valid choices
reasonAnalysis.gate: Existing live68-choice P029 comprehension/reason gates reused only for identical hashes/profile; excluded from formal estimates. Successful gates do not imply all free explanations are correct.

failureRule: First technical invalid, unknown network result, source/profile drift, repeated provider ID or budget/time stop ends the campaign. Preserve all partial records; mark formal incomplete, no automatic refill/restart or pooling. A valid free reason-quality problem is retained and coded, not a technical invalid.

exclusions.P029: All208 pilot replies and their208 provider IDs excluded; source forecasts are fixed stimulus estimates, not new independent physical samples
exclusions.physicalCalibration: 174 development Unity runs stay development evidence, not formal outcome trials

stimulusPolicy: Retain all6 abstract cells x2 wordings and8 physical scenarios x2 information conditions, including saturated conditions; no new maps, rewards, q, deadlines, personality, history or model changes
limits: No validated mapping from time to original Eq20 utility; physical extension analyzed separately
Only six earlier geometry seeds support fixed forecast means/ranges; no general forecast-accuracy claim
Same alias does not guarantee immutable backend; record raw provider metadata
Independent-binomial or exchangeable-block assumptions are not established human sampling
Pilot informed hypotheses, so this is a prospective replication after development, not an untouched initial hypothesis test
